stemMarkdown: The average age of a team of 15 members is 36 years. If the captain is 46 years old, what is the average age (in years) of the remaining members? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Total age $= 15 \times 36 = 540$. Excluding the captain leaves $540 - 46 = 494$ years across $14$ members, so the average is $\dfrac{494}{14} = 35.29$.
